errors.text: The hypothesis changes the target problem from calculating the melting free energy of disordered TaVCrW to comparing BCC and Laves-phase stability in other Ta-based alloys.
It does not identify the required moment tensor potential (MTP), instead conflating an interatomic potential with a Holder-mean property-regression model.
The proposed mechanism omits the key FEP convergence criterion: a small-variance MTP–DFT energy difference arising from close reproduction of the DFT phase-space distribution.
None of the cited evidence validates MTP-based free-energy perturbation, replacement of TOR-TILD, or the claimed computational savings and free-energy accuracy.
The falsification experiment does not use a genuinely held-out configuration or composition set, so agreement could result from training-set overlap rather than transferable efficiency.
